title: churvey question set
description: A list of questions to put to consumer chatbots, with run defaults. Format id: churvey/questions@1. Validate with `churvey questions validate`.

name.description: Short lowercase slug; also the file name in ~/.churvey/questions/<name>.json.

language.description: Language the questions are written in, e.g. fr, en.

defaults.description: Used by `churvey run` unless overridden on the command line.

repeat.description: How many times each question is asked.

private.description: Use the site's private / temporary chat where it has one.

id.description: Stable slug. Generated from the text when missing; never change it once a run used it.

text.description: The question exactly as it is typed into the chatbot.

group.description: Links questions that belong together, e.g. two phrasings of one item.

meta.description: Free-form extra data (answer key, premise_true / premise_false, source...). Two keys reach the extension: followup_of (ask in the same chat right after that question id) and attachments (image URLs, Claude only).
